name: Speak with Gramma
summary: Tommy Joe Stonefield seeks Gramma Stonefield's help to meet Maybell Maclure. Their families' bitter feud keeps the young lovers apart, and Tommy Joe hopes his grandmother can find a way for them to see each other.

sections.title: A Feud and Forbidden Love
sections.body: Tommy Joe Stonefield and Maybell Maclure keep their romance secret from their feuding families. The Stonefields and Maclures have fought over their farms for years, making their neighboring homesteads hostile ground. Tommy Joe wants to meet Maybell without provoking violence between their kin, so he turns to his grandmother for help.

sections.title: Gramma's Cunning
sections.body: Gramma Stonefield stays indoors, but she knows the feud well. She understands that the families cannot truly unite while their bad blood remains. Still, she will not let their grudge crush young love. Rather than urge caution, Gramma begins looking for small chances to bring Tommy Joe and Maybell together.

faq.q: Why does Tommy Joe want me to speak with his Gramma?
faq.answer: Tommy Joe loves Maybell Maclure, but their families' feud keeps them from meeting. He hopes his grandmother can help arrange secret meetings without stirring an uproar.

faq.q: Where can Gramma Stonefield be found?
faq.answer: Gramma Stonefield stays inside the main Stonefield farmhouse, south of Goldshire and east of the riverbank where Tommy Joe hides.

faq.q: What is the feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures?
faq.answer: The neighboring farming families have a long personal and territorial grudge. They accuse each other of theft and compete over crops, while distrust keeps both households near violence. Their children must keep any contact secret.

faq.q: Does Gramma Stonefield oppose Tommy Joe's relationship?
faq.answer: No. Gramma knows the feud makes a lasting future difficult, but she cares for the young lovers and is willing to devise ways for them to meet.

faq.q: What happens after speaking to Gramma?
faq.answer: Gramma begins making a plan to bring Tommy Joe and Maybell together in secret. She sends you to gather what she needs for an invisibility liquor to get past their watchful families.
Maybell Maclure is the daughter of the rival family, living across the road from the Stonefields. She is secretly courting Tommy Joe Stonefield.

angles.text: As a human in Elwynn, you see how deeply local grudges run in Stormwind's heartlands, even amid wider troubles across the realm.
While Stormwind faces Defias unrest and beast attacks, you may find yourself mediating quarrels between neighboring farmers.
